title: JPMorgan Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 36% and Holds $540 Million in Bitcoin ETFs
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

JPMorgan Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 36% and Holds $540 Million in Bitcoin ETFs

A 13F filed Thursday shows JPMorgan held 848,932 Strategy shares, up 36% from June, and 11.4 million IBIT shares worth $540 million at Sept. 30, weeks before MSCI's index exit.

This post JPMorgan Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 36% and Holds $540 Million in Bitcoin ETFs first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Crypto Exchange Gemini Sells U.K. and EU Units to KAST for Under $10 Million
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Crypto Exchange Gemini Sells U.K. and EU Units to KAST for Under $10 Million

A person familiar with the matter said Gemini sold its already shuttered U.K. and European operations to Singapore payments firm KAST for less than $10 million, hours before the exchange reports third-quarter results. Gemini declined to comment.

This post Crypto Exchange Gemini Sells U.K. and EU Units to KAST for Under $10 Million first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: BNY Mellon Raises Its Strive (ASST) Stake 28% to $7 Million as Monday’s 13F Deadline Nears
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

BNY Mellon Raises Its Strive (ASST) Stake 28% to $7 Million as Monday’s 13F Deadline Nears

A Nov. 5 13F shows Bank of New York Mellon held 237,100 Strive shares worth $6.97 million at Sept. 30, up 51,544 shares from June, with other large filers still due Monday.

This post BNY Mellon Raises Its Strive (ASST) Stake 28% to $7 Million as Monday’s 13F Deadline Nears first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Rumble (RUM) Sells Two-Thirds of Its Bitcoin as AI Cloud Business Delivers First Profitable Quarter
summary:

Rumble (RUM) Sells Two-Thirds of Its Bitcoin as AI Cloud Business Delivers First Profitable Quarter

RUM Group held 94.68 bitcoin worth $7.9 million on Sept. 30, down from 293.14 at the end of June, as its Quake AI unit drove record revenue of $96.6 million.

title: BlackRock’s IBIT Bleeds $2 Billion in Nine Straight Days of Outflows
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

BlackRock’s IBIT Bleeds $2 Billion in Nine Straight Days of Outflows

U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs lost $299.8 million on Wednesday, their fifth straight day of outflows, with BlackRock's IBIT accounting for $269.7 million and about 94% of November's withdrawals.

This post BlackRock’s IBIT Bleeds $2 Billion in Nine Straight Days of Outflows first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
